item.title: [CRIT] [KEV] CVE-2026-88779 — Citrix NetScaler: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
item.description: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.
